clauses.text: A person who keeps a firearm in a residence shall store it in a locked container when it is not being carried or used.
The Department shall issue a storage certificate to each applicant upon payment of a fee of twenty-five dollars ($25).
This act occupies the whole field of firearm storage regulation. A city or county may not adopt or enforce any ordinance relating to firearm storage.

current_law: No state law governs firearm storage in a residence. Cities and counties may adopt storage ordinances.
